data.long_meaning: The name Quentin is derived from the Latin name Quintus, which means 'fifth' in Roman numerals. This name is popular among Christians due to its biblical connection and its meaning of being the fifth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Quentin has had a significant impact on popular culture, particularly in the English-speaking world. It has been borne by numerous well-known figures throughout history, including Quentin Tarantino, an American filmmaker and writer; Quentin Reynolds, a CBS director and commentator; and Quentin Crisp, an English-Australian actor and author. The name also has appeared in various fictional works, such as Quentin coldwater from the television series "The Magicians" and Quentin Jacobsen from the novel "Me and Earl and the Dying Girl."
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Quentin lies in its association with the biblical passage of Quinquagesima. This marks the beginning of Lent, a period of Christian observance leading up to Easter. As a name associated with the fifth book of the Old Testament, Quentin carries a reminder of the importance of the Lenten season and the faith journey that it represents. The name also highlights the idea of being the fifth, which can be interpreted as representing a call to be the fifth disciple, the fifth servant, or the fifth follower of Christ.
